name: phil/rate-limit-bundle
description: Rate limits declared on Symfony controllers, routes and forms: an attribute, a route default and a form option naming limiters over symfony/rate-limiter, keys hashed from the client's address or the user, 429 answers with Retry-After and the IETF RateLimit headers, JSON problems for APIs, a Twig page for the others, and an event on each refusal

suggest.phil/ip-anonymizer: To count the ip keys by network, so that an IPv6 subscriber's /64 shares one key
suggest.psr/log: For the warning logged when a limiter in observation would have refused a request
suggest.symfony/form: To limit the submissions of forms by their name
suggest.symfony/lock: For exact counts when requests of one key run at once
suggest.symfony/security-core: For the user and user_or_ip keys of the signed-in user
suggest.symfony/translation: For the refusal page and the form error in the request's language
suggest.twig/twig: For the HTML page of a refusal
